_comments._about: Copy this file to apply/user/library.json. The setup UI manages it for you, so you rarely edit it by hand. Each entry in resumes describes one uploaded PDF.
_comments.resumes: List of resume entries. Normally empty until you upload PDFs through the Resumes tab.
_comments.resumes[].id: Stable id assigned by serve.py when the PDF is uploaded.
_comments.resumes[].label: Human name for this resume, for example 'ML research' or 'Backend SWE'.
_comments.resumes[].file: Filename of the PDF inside apply/user/files/.
_comments.resumes[].tags: List of lowercase keywords used to match this resume to a job description, for example ["ml", "python", "research"].
_comments.resumes[].added: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the entry was created.
